scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,worker -c orange,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @relix/api" "npm run dev -w @relix/web" "npm run dev -w @relix/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @relix/shared && npm run build -w @relix/api && npm run build -w @relix/web && npm run build -w @relix/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @relix/shared && npm run typecheck -w @relix/api && npm run typecheck -w @relix/web && npm run typecheck -w @relix/worker
scripts.test: npm run test -w @relix/api && npm run test -w @relix/worker
